from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the legal proceeding."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party as named in the text")
    role: str = Field(description="Legal role or status (e.g., Appellant, Plaintiff, Defendant)")

class Ruling(BaseModel):
    """A specific ruling, fee order, or decision clause extracted from the document."""
    action_type: str = Field(description="The nature of the court action (e.g., Compensate, Dismiss, Maintain)")
    text: str = Field(description="Verbatim text of the clause")
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Monetary amount mentioned in this clause, if any")
    fee_liability: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who is liable for fees, if mentioned")

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """High-level metadata about the case."""
    case_type: str = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., Civil Second Instance, Administrative Retrial, State Compensation)")
    court_level: Optional[str] = Field(description="Court level mentioned, e.g., Supreme Court, High Court")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party]
    rulings: list[Ruling]
    case_info: list[CaseInfo]
